fields.name: products
fields.short: An array of products that are currently enabled for the company.

fields.name: redirect
fields.short: The `redirect` [Link URL](https://docs.codat.io/auth-flow/authorize-hosted-link) enabling the customer to start their auth flow journey for the company.

fields.name: referenceParentCompany
fields.short: The parent entity or controlling organization of this company.

fields.name: referenceSubsidiaryCompanies
fields.short: A list of subsidiary companies owned or controlled by this entity.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: A collection of user-defined key-value pairs that store custom metadata against the company.

fields.name: totalResults
fields.short: Total number of items.

fields.name: dataProvidedBy

fields.name: enabled
fields.short: Whether this integration is enabled for your customers to use.

fields.name: integrationId
fields.short: A Codat ID representing the integration.

fields.name: isBeta
fields.short: `True` if the integration is currently in beta release.

fields.name: isOfflineConnector
fields.short: `True` if the integration is to an application installed and run locally on an SMBs computer.

fields.name: key
fields.short: A unique 4-letter key to represent a platform in each integration.

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.short: Static url for integration's logo.

fields.name: name
fields.short: Name of integration.

fields.name: pageNumber
fields.short: Current page number.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.short: Number of items to return in results array.

fields.name: sourceId
fields.short: A source-specific ID used to distinguish between different sources originating from the same data connection.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.short: The type of platform of the connection.

fields.name: totalResults
fields.short: Total number of items.

fields.name: confirmCompanyName

fields.name: iconUrl

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.short: Static url to your organization's logo.

fields.name: name

fields.name: redirectUrl
fields.short: The redirect URL pasted on to the SMB once Codat's [Hosted Link](https://docs.codat.io/auth-flow/authorize-hosted-link) has been completed by the SMB.

fields.name: whiteListUrls
fields.short: A list of urls that are allowed to communicate with Codat.

fields.name: changes
fields.short: Contains a single entry that communicates which record has changed and the manner in which it changed.

fields.name: companyId
fields.short: Unique identifier for your SMB in Codat.

fields.name: completedOnUtc
fields.short: The datetime when the push was completed, null if Pending.

fields.name: dataConnectionKey
fields.short: Unique identifier for a company's data connection.

fields.name: dataType
fields.short: The type of data being pushed, eg invoices, customers.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.short: A message about the error.

fields.name: pageNumber
fields.short: Current page number.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.short: Number of items to return in results array.

fields.name: pushOperationKey
fields.short: A unique identifier generated by Codat to represent this single push operation.

fields.name: requestedOnUtc
fields.short: The datetime when the push was requested.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The current status of the push operation.

fields.name: statusCode
fields.short: Push status code.

fields.name: timeoutInMinutes
fields.short: Number of minutes the push operation must complete within before it times out.

fields.name: timeoutInSeconds
fields.short: Number of seconds the push operation must complete within before it times out.

fields.name: totalResults
fields.short: Total number of items.

fields.name: validation
fields.short: A human-readable object describing validation decisions Codat has made when pushing data into the platform.

fields.name: dataType
fields.short: Available data types

fields.name: fetchOnFirstLink
fields.short: Whether this data type should be queued after a company has authorized a connection.

fields.name: isLocked
fields.short: `True` if the [sync setting](https://docs.codat.io/knowledge-base/advanced-sync-settings) is locked.

fields.name: monthsToSync
fields.short: Months of data to fetch, for report data types (`balanceSheet` & `profitAndLoss`) only.

fields.name: syncFromUtc
fields.short: Date from which data should be fetched.

fields.name: syncFromWindow
fields.short: Number of months of data to be fetched.

fields.name: syncOrder
fields.short: The sync in which data types are queued for a sync.

fields.name: syncSchedule
fields.short: Number of hours after which this data type should be refreshed.

info.description:
An API for the common components of all of Codat's products.

These end points cover creating and managing your companies, data connections, and integrations.

[Read about the building blocks of Codat...](https://docs.codat.io/core-concepts/companies) | [See our OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/codatio/oas) 

---
<!-- Start Codat Tags Table -->
## Endpoints

| Endpoints | Description |
| :- |:- |
| Companies | Create and manage your SMB users' companies. |
| Connections | Create new and manage existing data connections for a company. |
| Connection management | Configure connection management UI and retrieve access tokens for authentication. |
| Webhooks | Create and manage webhooks that listen to Codat's events. |
| Integrations | Get a list of integrations supported by Codat and their logos. |
| Refresh data | Initiate data refreshes, view pull status and history. |
| Settings | Manage company profile configuration, sync settings, and API keys. |
| Push data | Initiate and monitor Create, Update, and Delete operations. |
| Supplemental data | Configure and pull additional data you can include in Codat's standard data types. |
| Custom data type | Configure and pull additional data types that are not included in Codat's standardized data model. |
<!-- End Codat Tags Table -->
